summary: PASS — Simplified AppLockGate verified end-to-end. Lint clean (0 errors). All forbidden strings absent (sessionUnlockedRef, lastUnlockedAtRef, requestAnimationFrame, attempt N/3, setLocked(() => false), 'Debounce active'). All required strings present exactly as specified. setLocked(false) appears exactly once (line 57, inside commitUnlock), setLocked(true) exactly once (line 87, inside maybeLock). commitUnlock is invoked from tryBiometric on res.success (line 142) and from pressDigit on verifyPin true (line 171). Render guard is the simple form `if (!locked) return <>{children}</>;` at line 190. Runtime smoke: app loads with no red-screen, guest login works, Profile screen renders, App Lock modal opens (shows 'Set App Lock PIN' flow because guest has none set), and expected [AppLock] debug logs fire ('render: locked= false', 'maybeLock() called', 'App Lock disabled in prefs — skipping'). No page errors; only benign expo-notifications/shadow* deprecation warnings unrelated to this change.

verification_checks.render_guard: if (!locked) return <>{children}</>; (line 190) — plain state check, no ref/OR guard

runtime.app_lock_modal: opens (Set App Lock PIN pad shown for guest)

critical_code_review_comments: Code is now minimal and easy to reason about. commitUnlock does one clean setLocked(false); render guard is plain — no more state thrash.

Note (informational, not blocking): the auto-trigger useEffect at line 151 depends on tryBiometric, which itself depends on `bio.hasFace`/commitUnlock. Because commitUnlock is stable (useCallback with []), and tryBiometric only re-creates when bio.hasFace changes, autoTriggeredRef will correctly gate re-firing across renders. Verified logic-only; safe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AppLockGate is now in its simplified/bare-metal form (iteration 17). If future regressions occur on unlock, first check console for the single '[AppLock] UNLOCK NOW' log — if it fires but UI stays locked, the issue is elsewhere (parent remounting AppLockGate, or maybeLock being re-invoked). Do NOT reintroduce debounce/triple-fire/session refs.
rca_of_issue: Previous overengineering (sessionUnlockedRef sticky-ref + 3s debounce + triple-fire commitUnlock via setTimeout+rAF + functional setLocked + custom render guard) created setState races where setLocked(true) from maybeLock could clobber the ref-guarded render or reset just after commitUnlock's async dispatch. The simplified version removes all of that: exactly one setLocked(false) call inside commitUnlock, exactly one setLocked(true) inside maybeLock, and a plain `if (!locked) return children` render guard. Verified via file grep + runtime smoke.
